name: bfs_collect_one_level
why: One level collector is reused by ordinary, zigzag and bottom-up traversal; outer output ordering remains outside the fragment.

contracts.name: bfs_collect_one_level
contracts.precondition: Acyclic binary tree nodes; level output empty. JS source frontier is not modified during iteration; next-frontier is separate. Python deque initial length defines level size; appending children is intentional.
contracts.effects: JS appends values and children to two distinct output arrays. Python consumes current nodes and appends children on the same deque; appends values to a separate list. Bound temporaries must be fresh, distinct from operand handles.
contracts.fixed_constants: Tree field names val,left,right; traversal order left before right; Python len(q) evaluated once.

name: skip_adjacent_equal_values
why: After emitting a tuple, advance the selected pointer over equal neighbor values. Direction and pointer bindings are explicit operands.

contracts.name: skip_adjacent_equal_values
contracts.precondition: Integer in-range pointers into sorted dense numeric array, after emitting a tuple and moving both pointers. Compare only while left<right.
contracts.effects: Moves one pointer inward over values equal to the just-emitted neighbor; reads array without mutation. Language equality retains original semantics.
contracts.fixed_constants: Offset and step of one; direction is a charged variant byte, not a free channel.
